alignment_method: hybrid: tfidf shortlist -> grade+keyword rerank -> LLM curation (Claude Sonnet)
notes: High-school literary analysis essay. Objective-level alignment; logistical objectives (file naming, length quota) receive no substantive ELA alignment.

objectives.title: Naming Convention
objectives.description: Follow the file naming convention of: Your Name | Period # | Assignment Name
objectives.note: Logistical/operational. No ELA content standard applies.

objectives.title: Essay Length
objectives.description: Your essay must be 500-1000 words and contain at least five paragraphs.

alignments.rationale: Length, paragraph-count, and coherent structure expectations fall under 'produce clear and coherent writing in which the development, organization, and style are appropriate to task, purpose, and audience.'

objectives.title: Essay Elements
objectives.description: Include two hyperlinks and two images that are relevant information this essay.

alignments.rationale: Use of hyperlinks / embedded images is the production-and-publishing-with-technology standard.
Integrating graphics/media with text when writing informative/explanatory content.

objectives.title: Essay Content
objectives.description: Include character names, locations, scenes, etc... in your text.

alignments.rationale: Analyzing complex characters, their interactions with setting, and how they advance plot/theme — the knowledge an essay must surface about the novel.
Applying Reading standards to literature: draw evidence from literary texts to support analysis.

objectives.title: Subjective AI
objectives.description: Subjective AI Evaluations covering Depth of Analysis, Clarity and Coherence, Engagement and Originality, Use of Textual Evidence, and Emotional and Intellectual Impact.

alignments.rationale: Literary analysis essay = argument writing: introduce a thesis, develop claims with evidence, and maintain cohesion. The AI evaluation criteria map directly onto W.*.1 sub-components.
Develop claim(s) and counterclaims fairly, supplying evidence for each.
Cite strong and thorough textual evidence to support analysis — maps to 'Use of Textual Evidence' criterion.

objectives.title: Objective AI
objectives.description: Objective: Spelling, Grammar and Syntax, Formatting, Organized Ideas into Paragraphs, and LEngth.

alignments.rationale: Demonstrate command of conventions of standard English grammar and usage.
Capitalization, punctuation, and spelling when writing.
'Organized Ideas into Paragraphs' and 'Length' fold into producing clear, coherent writing appropriate to task and purpose.
